events.sub: Rumi, Shams and the stories of old Persia, from the original Persian

events.text: Here we read Rumi, Shams, and the great storytellers of old Persia, from the original Persian.
Real verses, honest translations, and what they mean.

events.fa: هست مهمان‌خانه این تن ای جوان
events.en: This body is a guest house, young friend:

events.fa: هر صباحی ضیف نو آید دوان
events.en: every morning a new guest comes running.

events.text: This is the passage that gave our channel its name.
Whatever arrives in you today is a guest. And guests leave.

events.text: Every week: new verses of Rumi, and true stories from Beyhaqi's thousand year old history.
